Overview of Andalusia Region (Andalucía)

Andalusia Region (Andalucía) is located in the Andalusia region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Seville. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Seville Real Alcázar & Cathedral, Granada Alhambra & Albaicín, Córdoba Mezquita-Catedral, Ronda, White Villages & Málaga.

RegionAndalusia
Capital citySeville
Cities & municipalities119
Primary transport hubSeville Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Andalusia Region

AVE high-speed trains from Madrid to Córdoba (1h45), Seville (2h30), Málaga (2h40) and Granada; Málaga (AGP) & Seville (SVQ) airports. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Andalusia

When visiting cities across Andalusia, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Salmorejo & Gazpacho
  • Pescaíto frito
  • Jamón Ibérico de Jabugo
  • Espetos de sardinas (Málaga)
  • Sherry wines of Jerez

Best time to visit Andalusia

Best time to visit Andalusia: Mar–May, Sep–Nov.
